seoDescription: Learn what the Tongue emoji 👅 really means.

longForm.overview:
The 👅 Tongue emoji was added in Unicode 6 (2010) and is drawn as a single red tongue sticking out, no face around it. The visual cue reads instantly as tongue-out reaction, playful-coded lick, or the visible 'bleh' tag. By 2026 👅 has become the go-to emoji for the tongue-out reaction, the visible 'lick' default, and the playful-coded reaction in close-friends and dating chats.

In modern chat 👅 does very specific work. People send it as a literal tongue reference, as the visible 'bleh' tag, or as the playful-coded default. The red tongue and no-face format are the visual cue that the read is tongue-only. Writers should pick 👅 when the read is tongue-out or visible 'bleh' energy, and avoid it when the read is face-required — 😝 fits better there.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
👅 lands on a friend's playful tease, in a work channel where someone is signaling tongue-coded energy, and in a dating-app DM where the sender is reacting with flirty tongue energy. The red tongue anchors the read.

In close-friends chats 👅 reads as the universal tongue default and the visible 'bleh' tag. On X the emoji punctuates playful-coded and flirty-coded tweets. The emoji pairs with 😝 for the layered face-tongue stack and with 👄 for the layered mouth-and-tongue pair stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 👅 in any context where the read is face-required. The no-face format implies tongue-only. Avoid 👅 in formal contexts where the tongue-coded read lands as unprofessional.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 👅 on a playful-coded message, mirror with another 👅 or 😝 to match the energy. The tongue chain reads as solidarity.

If 👅 lands as the playful-coded default, reply with another 👅 or 👄. And if you want to send 👅 yourself, pair it with the moment so the tongue-coded read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 👅 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 👅 means tongue-out reaction, visible 'bleh' energy, or the playful-coded reaction. The red tongue and no-face format are the visual cue that the read is tongue-only.

faqs.question: Is 👅 flirty?
faqs.answer: Yes. 👅 is one of the most flirty-coded emojis in the standard set. In a dating thread it reads as visible 'bleh' or flirty tongue energy.

faqs.question: What does 👅 mean from a girl?
faqs.answer: From a girl or anyone, 👅 carries the same playful-coded read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 👅 mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram, 👅 is the default sticker on flirty-coded captions and tongue-out story overlays.
